request.spec:
A retired person can be unretired (a button on the row; PERSON_UNRETIRED name=<name> on=<the
sheet's today>; anyone not retired is refused with an error on the row). They are no longer retired
(retired no, no retired-from); the retirement is kept on the row as <from> to <the day unretired>, one line per past
retirement; and a claim dated after the from and before the to of a
past retirement is refused as a claim after a retirement is.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A retired person can be unretired (a button on the row; PERSON_UNRETIRED name=<name> on=<the
sheet's today>; anyone not retired is refused with an error on the row). They are no longer retired
(retired no, no retired-from); the retirement is kept on the row as <from> to <the day unretired>, one line per past
retirement; and a claim dated after the from and before the to of a
past retirement is refused as a claim after a retirement is.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A retired person can now be unretired, and all 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass. To get there I also had to fix two existing gaps in the "view the sheet as of a past date" feature that had nothing to do with unretiring.

**What unretire does**
- **Endpoint:** `POST /api/sheets/{sheetId}/people/{personId}/unretire` (`unretire.POST.yml`). It is refused with a 400 if the person isn't retired, and nothing is written. Otherwise the person is no longer retired and the audit file gets `PERSON_UNRETIRED sheet=… by=… name=… on=<sheet's today>`, followed by the usual ROLLUP/TOTALS lines. New steps are `ValidateUnretire`, `UnretirePerson` and `RecordPersonUnretired`.
- **Stored data:** migration `V65__person_retirement.sql` adds a `person_retirement` table that keeps each past retirement (from date, to date). An unretirement is also written to the existing retirement history as an empty date, so viewing the sheet as of a past date shows whether the person was retired then.
- **Claim rule:** `Person` now carries its past retirements. `mayClaimOn` refuses a claim dated after the from and before the to of a past retirement, through the same check that already refuses a claim dated after a current retirement. Claims on the from or to day itself are allowed.
- **Edits elsewhere:** retiring, holding or editing a person keeps their past retirements on the result. Merging a person deletes them; transferring a person moves them to the new sheet.
- **Screen:** the retire column on each row now has an Unretire button and one `person-retirement-line` per past retirement ("from to to"). The error only shows while unretire is the last action taken on that row.

**The two as-of fixes (outside the request)**
Scenario 2 never unretires anyone, but it checks values while the sheet is viewed as of an earlier date, and two of them were wrong:
- **Proof counts** always showed the current count. Migration `V66__claim_proof_log.sql` now records the date each proof is added, and the as-of view leaves out proofs added after the viewed date. Proofs added before this change have no recorded date, so they count from the beginning.
- **Pools** ignored the as-of date completely. `RespondWithPools` now passes it through, and `PoolRepository.list` uses it in place of the sheet's today when deciding who is an active member and who is on hold.

Both are small, but they change behaviour beyond what you asked for, so look at them before merging.
